title: Fire theme record
description: A product's look as one record: palette, tone, type and dials (the structural dials surfaces, elevation, controls and headings among them). Every field is optional (a missing field is Fire's default); an unknown field is an error. fire/js/theme.js validateTheme() applies the same rules; scripts/test/theme.test.mjs checks that the two agree and that the enums match Fire's palette and type set lists.

fire.description: The Fire release the record was written against; Facet and products pin the expander by it.

palette.description: A palette name, or a spec that fire/js/theme.js paletteFrom() turns into a palette that passes every preset rule.

tone.description: Bends whichever palette is selected, as the Tweaks panel's Tone sliders do.

vivid.description: Scales the accent's chroma, in percent (0 is a grey accent).

light.description: Shifts the accent's OKLCH lightness by this many hundredths.

warmth.description: Tints the neutrals toward blue (negative) or yellow-orange (positive).

type.description: A type set name, or a type set spec: families from the font catalogue (contract/fonts.json), a heading weight and tracking, heading case and figures. validateTheme() also enforces the pairing rules the catalogue allows (at most two families plus a mono; an interface family has an x-height ratio of at least 0.5; a display-only family is never the interface face; the mono is a mono; displayWeight is a weight the display family has). A family outside the catalogue is allowed and unchecked; the page loads it.

display.description: Headings: --fd-font-display. A catalogue family with the display role.

sans.description: The interface: --fd-font-sans. A catalogue family with the interface role (x-height ratio of at least 0.5, not display-only).

mono.description: Code, keys and eyebrows: --fd-font-mono. A catalogue mono.

displayWeight.description: --fd-weight-display: the heading weight, inside the display family's weights.

displayTracking.description: --fd-ls-display and --fd-ls-h1 to -h3: heading letter-spacing, in em.

headingCase.description: upper sets data-heading-case="upper" (headings in capitals); sentence is as written.

figures.description: tabular sets data-figures="tabular" (equal-width digits); proportional is the default.

corners.description: --fd-radius-scale: 0 square, 1 default, 2 round. Tweaks steps by 0.125.

contrast.description: data-contrast="high" strengthens muted text, lines and control edges.

texture.description: --fd-texture: the strength of the generative textures. Tweaks steps by 0.05.

surfaces.description: data-surfaces: objects (white objects with a hairline on an off-white page, the default), flat (tinted areas, no edges, separation by fill) or outlined (page and surface one colour, visible edges, inputs edged at 3:1).

elevation.description: data-elevation: none (no shadows; floating things take an edge), soft (the default) or lifted (deeper shadows, and objects lift off the page).

controls.description: data-controls: soft (the 4% ink wash, the default), outlined (an edge at 3:1 on a clear fill) or filled (a stronger wash), for the secondary button, the soft select, the soft search and the filter trigger. The primary button keeps its depth in every value.

headings.description: data-headings: the small labels (eyebrows, column headers, keys, group labels). sentence (the default: mono capitals, sans capitals for the sidebar's groups), upper (tracked sans capitals) or mono (the mono face, as written).

signature.description: The signature: Fire's generated texture and frame marks as one set of dials. Written as data-signature-* attributes on <html>, only where not the default; every texture not pinned with data-signature="own" takes the page's value over its own option.

field.description: data-signature-field: the field of every unpinned texture. "auto" leaves each instance its own.

mark.description: data-signature-mark: the mark a field is drawn in (data-style): characters, halftone discs, squares, plus signs or dashes. "auto" leaves each field its own.

cell.description: data-signature-cell: the cell width in px (the height follows). "auto" leaves each instance its own.

ramp.description: data-signature-ramp: a named character ramp, for the density levels of every mark. "auto" leaves each field its own.

marks.description: data-signature-marks: the marks where a frame's bands meet its rails (default "crosses"). A frame or band's own data-marks wins.

intensity.description: data-signature-intensity: the luminance multiplier of every texture without its own data-intensity. Tweaks steps by 0.05.

brand.description: The product's brand: the input of the shell's setBrand() (fire/js/shell.js), filling every .fd-brand on the page. Not CSS: expandTheme() returns it untouched and themeToCss() ignores it. Pictures are the page's own addresses, https addresses or data: images (the rules of safeImageUrl, without a host list).

name.description: The wordmark text and the alt text of a logo.

mark.description: A picture for the 24px mark slot; without it the mark is the dot-matrix initial of the name.

logo.description: A wide picture that stands in for the mark and the name.

logoDark.description: The logo for the dark scheme.

href.description: The link of a brand that is an <a>.

pictureAddress.description: A picture address: the page's own (relative), https, or a data: image, with no credentials and no control characters. validateTheme() applies the rules of safeImageUrl that need no page; the host list is the page's.

family.description: A font family name, quoted in CSS.

fromAccent.description: A palette built from one accent, on ember's lightness structure.

neutral.description: The neutrals' temperature: pure grey, cool (blue), warm (sand), tinted toward the accent (the default), or a hue in degrees.

on.description: The label on the accent fill. Left out: whichever reads better.

fromBrand.description: A palette built from brand colours: the engine picks the accent and the neutrals' temperature.

paletteSpec.description: The compact spec fire/js/palettes.js expands its presets from.

tint.description: Page chroma [light, dark]; surfaces, lines and washes scale from it.

h.description: The ink's hue, when it differs from the neutrals'.

accent.description: [light, dark?] accents (dark is derived when left out), or "ink" for a monochrome palette.

on.description: The label on the accent: white, a tinted near-black, or the page's inverse ink; one, or a [light, dark] pair.

L.description: Per-step OKLCH lightness overrides [light, dark]; null keeps ember's.

surfaceTint.description: Light-mode surface chroma relative to the page tint.
